name: Despair: four seconds of target-health damage
targetName: four seconds of Despair core magic damage
objective: Investigate high four seconds of Despair core magic damage output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
mechanic: The tooltip gives 10 flat magic damage plus (1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 + 0.005 AP)% enemy maximum HP per second. Rank 5 over four seconds nominally totals 40 plus (8 + 0.02 AP)% target maximum HP, before tick boundaries and mitigation. AP increases a target-health coefficient as well as item effects; this is not 0.5% per AP.
finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 4s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; no free permanent stacks. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. Stop observed scoring on death and report raw overkill separately. Seraph transformed through actual stacking. Riftmaker legally pre-ramped on a separate victim. One champion remains in aura for four seconds with enough observed mana to sustain it. Record whether Curse is already present; any Cursed Touch true-damage packet is separate from the selected W magic core.
test: Count actual aura ticks and timestamps. Compare 1500 and 6000 target maximum HP, and one AP slot against penetration. Run both cursed and uncursed controls where possible, recording true damage separately. Record Rylai contact uptime rather than treating its slow as a damage multiplier.
limits: No automatic full uptime or free mana; refresh of an existing Curse is not proof that an unmarked victim starts cursed. The passive true packet, item burns and rune procs are not silently folded into W magic damage.
tradeoff: Short-range aura contact and mana upkeep may outweigh the theoretical gain from a fragile six-item AP inventory.

mechanic: W grants 50/60/70/80/90 + 8/9/10/11/12% of Nautilus maximum HP as a shield for six seconds. AP scales the separate attack burn, not this shield helper. Purchased health and legally earned Heartsteel health can increase the core shield; eligible shield modifiers are a separate check.
